## Review checklist

- [ ] `make sync` and `make verify` pass.
- [ ] New behavior has a meaningful failing test before the implementation.
- [ ] Applicable ProductSpec criteria have evidence, or remain explicitly unverified.
- [ ] Core remains the owner of parsing, provenance, artifacts, and MCP semantics.
- [ ] No private documents, credentials, transcripts, or fabricated measurements are committed.
- [ ] Documentation and the changelog describe the actual scope.
- [ ] Finished proposal sections move into code or directory READMEs before their removal.
- [ ] Client compatibility claims name tested host versions and release artifact hashes.
